reviewContext.userProblem: nodetto has no spreadsheet-style element. Users need a first-class grid of typed columns and rows with a header row, per-column widths, per-row heights and cell text that displays and edits like an Excel sheet or a Notion table, distinct from the ERD erd.table element.
requiredOutcomes: A table.sheet element can be created from the toolbox (default 3x3), renders as header plus grid with typed cells in light and dark themes, and its bounds equal the sum of column widths and row heights.

In-place cell editing with Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape and arrow keys; rows and columns can be added, deleted, renamed, retyped and resized; every edit is one undo step through updateSemantic/createElement/updateVisual.
Pasting TSV fills a range and grows the table; copying a range yields TSV of stored values; cut is one undo step.
The inspector edits header row, striping and column properties, and adds or removes rows and columns.
Validation rejects duplicate ids, unknown column keys, type mismatches and limit violations with table.* issue codes; valid tables round-trip through JSONL unchanged.
SVG and PNG export render the table like the canvas, verified by SVG output tests.
The CLI creates tables from inline data and CSV/TSV, edits cells (table set, set-cells edit op), lints and exports them; docs/cli.md and help text describe it.
docs/editing.md documents the shape and design-docs/specs/design-table-sheet.md exists and is marked implemented.
mise run lint, bun run typecheck, mise run test, mise run test-cli, mise run build-cli and mise run build pass; erd.table behavior is unchanged.
nonGoals: Formulas, sorting, filtering, merged cells, frozen panes, multi-line cell layout, per-cell fonts other than bold.
HTML/mobile code handoff, draw.io, Mermaid and D2 export of tables.
Rust-native code changes, new Command kinds, version bumps or releases.

Any change to erd.table schema, behavior, rendering or tests (packages/ir/src/registry/erd.ts, packages/ir/src/semantics/erd.ts, packages/core/src/shapes/erdTable.ts, packages/ui-solid/src/shapes/ErdTableView.tsx) or to packages/core/src/commands.ts.
Server code, auth, secrets or deployment config in this public repository.
constraints: Follow AGENTS.md; no emojis; cargo commands use CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true.
Pinned contracts in impl-plans/active/tsh-00-overview.md are binding and must not be renamed.

Shared-engine code (packages/ir, packages/core, apps/cli/src) runs in Boa: no node:* imports outside tests, no regex split over whole documents, CSV/TSV parsers are character scanners, no time, randomness or locale APIs.
Strict TypeScript; guard indexed lookups; read record keys with Object.hasOwn.
Every document change is one editor.apply updateSemantic or the existing createElement/updateVisual paths; no new Command kind so the private Worker authoring-discovery stays exhaustive.

All plans share one branch and working directory. Workers run no state-changing git commands, edit only their writePaths and own progress log, record pre/post git hash-object per edit, and run Biome only on owned files.

Each verification command must exit 0 and run at least one test once the plan lands; bun test paths are ./-prefixed. mise run test-cli may be attempted up to 3 times under load; deadlines are never relaxed; skipped native tests count as failures.
If bun run typecheck fails only in a sibling plan's unfinished file, record it and rerun after that sibling finishes; it must exit 0 on the final tree.
Tests use only self-authored neutral data (Widget, Todo, alpha, beta, #ffeeaa).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: New registry module packages/ir/src/registry/table.ts with semantics in packages/ir/src/semantics/table.ts; core pure modules under packages/core/src/table-sheet/.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps the feature in new modules so wave-2 plans run in parallel and erd.table is untouched.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Edits go through applyTableSheetEdit, which issues exactly one updateSemantic (none for a no-op); cell editing uses editor.endBatch on commit and editor.abortBatch on cancel.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One undo step per edit, cancelled drags record no history, and collaboration keeps working without new Command kinds.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Toolbox default table uses fixed ids c1..c3 / r1..r3; later rows and columns use newElementId.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Tool creation takes the util's static defaults; ids need only be unique within one table (tsh-00 refinement 2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Shape catalogue id is table.sheet, not table:sheet.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Catalogue ids are ToolKind values; tsh-08 corrects the design wording (tsh-00 refinement 5).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Clipboard copies stored values through an injected TableClipboardPort; tsh-08 binds it to navigator.clipboard.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps tsh-04 testable without DOM clipboard and preserves exact stored text (TABLE-DESIGN-001).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: tsh-06 owns apps/cli/src/edit/batch.ts and operation-fields.ts; commands.ts, help.ts and types-command.ts stay with tsh-08.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: set-cells becomes testable through runOperations in wave 2 while shared dispatch stays serial (tsh-00 refinement 1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Dispatch verification for tsh-01 and tsh-04 uses directory filters with a trailing slash (./packages/core/src/table-sheet/ and ./packages/ui-solid/src/table-sheet/).
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: bun test treats the path as a substring filter; the trailing slash enforces each plan's own requirement that the log lists only files under that directory and excludes sibling files such as table-sheet-view.test.ts or table-sheet-export.test.ts.

intentionalTradeoffs: Export text truncation uses estimated text widths, so ellipsis points may differ slightly from the browser.
Select pill colors derive from option index into a fixed palette; no color is stored.
The cell editor is single-line; newlines reach text cells only through paste or the CLI.
Concurrent edits to the same cell are last writer wins.
supportedEdgeCases: Paste larger than the table grows rows and columns up to limits (100 columns, 1000 rows) and reports table.limit beyond them.
Paste coerces values to column types; non-matching values are skipped and counted; select columns gain new options.
Deleting the last remaining column is refused (table.lastColumn).
Dates are validated as real YYYY-MM-DD calendar dates including leap years.
CSV parsing follows RFC 4180 with an optional UTF-8 BOM; --no-header input generates column names.
Escape while editing cancels with no history entry; a double-click on a column border resets width to 120.
Arrow keys nudge the element only when no cell is active.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Formulas, sorting, filtering, merged cells and frozen panes.
Tauri WKWebView clipboard permission behavior beyond what tsh-08 observes and records.
residualRisks: low: Tauri WKWebView clipboard permission is not verified; tsh-08 records what it observes.
